summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of MiniAtlas Quest across all 4 pages (Explore India, World Explorer, Learn & Play, Passport) on desktop (1280) and mobile (390) viewports. Core functionality (navigation, map, detail panels, mark-learned + localStorage persistence, search/filter/sort, symbols, quizzes, flashcards, capital match, passport, reset flow, mobile nav) is WORKING as confirmed from captured runtime data. One critical React runtime bug was found on the Passport page: 'Maximum update depth exceeded' console errors caused by an infinite render loop between setJourney and the useEffect in Passport.jsx.

ui_bugs.issue: React 'Maximum update depth exceeded' error fires repeatedly when visiting the Passport page. Root cause: setJourney(kind, val) in /app/frontend/src/context/ProgressContext.jsx always spreads and produces a NEW progress object (and NEW journey object) even when the value is unchanged. That triggers useMemo(computeBadges) in Passport.jsx to recompute and return a brand-new Set, which changes the 'unlocked' dependency of the useEffect at lines 20-27, which in turn calls setJourney again -> infinite loop. Observed 8+ console errors during a single passport visit.

action_items: FIX INFINITE LOOP on Passport: In /app/frontend/src/context/ProgressContext.jsx, make setJourney a no-op when the value is unchanged. Change to: setJourney: (kind, val) => setProgress((p) => { const nv = Math.max(p.journey[kind], val); return nv === p.journey[kind] ? p : { ...p, journey: { ...p.journey, [kind]: nv } }; })

ADDITIONAL SAFETY: In Passport.jsx useEffect (lines 20-27), either (a) memoize the unlocked Set as an Array with useMemo returning a stable representation (e.g. join a sorted array of ids), or (b) drop 'unlocked' from the dep array and iterate inline, or (c) guard the unlockBadge/setJourney calls with a shallow equality check. Best long-term fix: also make unlockBadge idempotent (already is) and change the effect to depend on primitive values (indiaPct, worldPct, and a serialized string of unlocked ids).
critical_code_review_comments: ProgressContext.setJourney creates a new state object on every call regardless of whether Math.max changed the value; combined with useMemo returning a fresh Set on every render this reliably produces the observed infinite update loop.
Passport.jsx useEffect uses a Set (reference-unstable) as a dependency; should be replaced with a stable primitive dep.
computeBadges returns a new Set each call; consumers that use it as a dep should stabilize it via useMemo returning a stable, serialized value.

The rest of the codebase is clean, well-structured, uses proper data-testid coverage, no hardcoded URLs, no backend calls, no MongoDB _id concerns, and all localStorage persistence works under key 'miniatlas_quest_v1' as designed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Playwright script had a test-framework bug: 'asyncio.sleep(0) or ok' returned a truthy coroutine, so the 'or ok' short-circuited to the coroutine (which awaits to None) making many assertions falsely report FAIL. However the raw runtime data captured in the output prints (e.g. 'stat-india: 2', 'Learned filter cards: 2', 'Asia filter cards: 24', 'Load More: 48', 'match rounds: 0->1', 'Japan capital: Tokyo', 'scrollW=1280 clientW=1280', 'scrollW=390 clientW=390', 'India Quiz 5 score: 0 / 5') confirms functionality is actually working. Next iteration should rewrite the check helper to use plain awaited booleans (e.g. `await check('name', bool_value)` after awaiting the underlying is_visible/query call). The one real bug is the 'Maximum update depth exceeded' console error emitted only on the Passport page - please prioritize that fix. After fix, re-navigate to /passport and confirm zero React errors in console during a 5s dwell + one Reset -> Confirm flow.
rca of the issue: In /app/frontend/src/context/ProgressContext.jsx line 75-76, setJourney always returns a NEW top-level state via ({...p, journey: {...p.journey, [kind]: Math.max(...)}}) - the new object is not referentially equal to the old one even when Math.max produces the same value. React sees progress state changed => Passport re-renders => useMemo(computeBadges, [progress]) runs and returns a new Set (Sets are always new refs) => useEffect deps ([unlocked, indiaPct, worldPct]) change every render because 'unlocked' identity always changes => useEffect calls setJourney('india', indiaPct) & setJourney('world', worldPct) again => loop. React eventually throws 'Maximum update depth exceeded'. Mitigation options are listed in action_items.
